applicableAreas: Title blocks on all affected sheets
findings.comment: The 'Y' total sheet count in the title block is inconsistent across the plan set. Sheets 1-29 correctly display 'X of 39', but landscape sheets 30-37 incorrectly display 'of 35' (showing sheet numbers 27-34 of 35 instead of 30-37 of 39). The cover sheet approval block and sheet index clearly establish 39 total sheets. All sheets in a plan set must reflect the same total sheet count regardless of discipline.

applicableAreas: Cover sheet - Integrated Pest Management Plan reference block
findings.comment: The cover sheet contains a reference field for the Integrated Pest Management Plan that requires a recorded document number, but the field is left completely blank. The note reads 'For Integrated Pest Management Plan, see agreement filed in document No.____' with no actual document number provided. All blank references to recorded document numbers must be replaced with actual issued document numbers.
